content.json:
# Tribal Kava conversion dashboard
Visits, menu interest, directions, calls, DoorDash checkout starts, VIP, events, and drink-finder activity from the live site. Local preview and QA traffic are excluded.

content.title: Conversion actions
content.query:
let live = customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where tostring(customDimensions.page_location) has 'thetribalkavalounge.com'
| where tostring(customDimensions.campaign_medium) != 'qa';
datatable(Action:string, Sort:int, EventName:string)[
'DoorDash checkout starts', 1, 'begin_checkout',
'Order-link clicks', 2, 'order_online',
'Menu views', 3, 'menu_view',
'Directions', 4, 'directions',
'Phone calls', 5, 'phone_call',
'VIP texts', 6, 'vip_sms',
'VIP emails', 7, 'vip_email',
'Event interest', 8, 'event_interest',
'Event inquiries', 9, 'event_inquiry',
'Drink recommendations', 10, 'drink_recommendation'
]
| join kind=leftouter (live | summarize Actions=count(), People=dcount(user_Id), Sessions=dcount(session_Id) by EventName=name) on EventName
| project Action, Actions=coalesce(Actions, 0), People=coalesce(People, 0), Sessions=coalesce(Sessions, 0), Sort
| order by Sort asc
| project-away Sort

content.title: Visits and high-intent actions over time
content.query:
let pages = pageViews
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where url has 'thetribalkavalounge.com'
| where tostring(customDimensions.campaign_medium) != 'qa'
| summarize PageViews=count() by bin(timestamp, 1d);
let actions = customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where tostring(customDimensions.page_location) has 'thetribalkavalounge.com'
| where tostring(customDimensions.campaign_medium) != 'qa'
| where name in ('menu_view', 'order_online', 'begin_checkout', 'directions', 'phone_call', 'vip_sms', 'vip_email', 'event_interest', 'event_inquiry', 'drink_recommendation')
| summarize Actions=count() by bin(timestamp, 1d);
pages
| join kind=fullouter actions on timestamp
| project timestamp=coalesce(timestamp, timestamp1), PageViews=coalesce(PageViews, 0), Actions=coalesce(Actions, 0)
| order by timestamp asc

content.title: Visits → menu → directions/calls → DoorDash
content.query:
let livePages = pageViews
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where url has 'thetribalkavalounge.com'
| where tostring(customDimensions.campaign_medium) != 'qa';
let liveEvents = customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where tostring(customDimensions.page_location) has 'thetribalkavalounge.com'
| where tostring(customDimensions.campaign_medium) != 'qa';
datatable(Stage:string, Sort:int, EventName:string)[
'Site sessions', 1, 'page_view',
'Menu sessions', 2, 'menu_view',
'Directions / calls', 3, 'visit_intent',
'DoorDash checkout starts', 4, 'begin_checkout'
]
| join kind=leftouter (
    union (livePages | summarize Sessions=dcount(session_Id) | extend EventName='page_view'),
          (liveEvents | where name in ('menu_view', 'begin_checkout') | summarize Sessions=dcount(session_Id) by EventName=name),
          (liveEvents | where name in ('directions', 'phone_call') | summarize Sessions=dcount(session_Id) | extend EventName='visit_intent')
  ) on EventName
| project Stage, Sessions=coalesce(Sessions, 0), Sort
| order by Sort asc
| project-away Sort

content.title: Google, Instagram, QR, and direct action sources
content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where tostring(customDimensions.page_location) has 'thetribalkavalounge.com'
| where tostring(customDimensions.campaign_medium) != 'qa'
| where name in ('menu_view', 'order_online', 'begin_checkout', 'directions', 'phone_call', 'vip_sms', 'vip_email', 'event_interest', 'event_inquiry', 'drink_recommendation')
| extend Source=tostring(customDimensions.campaign_source), Medium=tostring(customDimensions.campaign_medium), Campaign=tostring(customDimensions.campaign_name)
| summarize Actions=count(), People=dcount(user_Id), MenuClicks=countif(name == 'menu_view'), CheckoutStarts=countif(name == 'begin_checkout'), Directions=countif(name == 'directions'), Calls=countif(name == 'phone_call') by Source, Medium, Campaign
| order by Actions desc

content.title: What the drink finder recommends
content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where tostring(customDimensions.page_location) has 'thetribalkavalounge.com'
| where tostring(customDimensions.campaign_medium) != 'qa'
| where name == 'drink_recommendation'
| extend Drink=tostring(customDimensions.recommended_item), Base=tostring(customDimensions.botanical), Flavor=tostring(customDimensions.flavor), Moment=tostring(customDimensions.vibe)
| summarize Recommendations=count(), People=dcount(user_Id) by Drink, Base, Flavor, Moment
| order by Recommendations desc
